interface.description: Network interface or IP address to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1', 'eth0', '::'). Use '0.0.0.0' or '::' to bind to all interfaces.

allow_ipv4.description: Whether to allow IPv4 ping requests.

allow_ipv6.description: Whether to allow IPv6 ping requests.

default.description: Note: 172.16.0.0/12 is Class-B-like but spans multiple /16 blocks. Use only strict /16 for true Class-B.

allowed_networks.description: List of allowed networks in CIDR notation. By default, includes common private Class-B ranges. Each network must be /16 (IPv4) or /64 (IPv6).

log_level.description: Log level: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency.

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty or undefined, logs go to syslog.

ssl_enabled.description: Whether to enable encrypted transport (requires certificate and key).

ssl_cert.description: Path to SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format).

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format).

default.description: 10 pings per second per source IP

max_rate.description: Maximum pings allowed per source IP per second. Helps prevent abuse.

default.description: Disable symmetric routing check by default

require_symmetric.description: If true, require the source IP of the incoming ping to match the destination IP (useful for routing verification).
